items.title: Italy-Vietnam Agreement on Food Safety and Public Health
items.description: (ANSA) - ROMA, 26 NOV - As part of Italian Cuisine Week in Vietnam, a workshop titled “Food Safety: Framework and Prospects in Italy and the EU.
